about: Smart rotation's weights (docs/sandbox/CONSTRUCTS.md, 'Smart rotation'; Source/Constructs/SmartRotation.cs): every turn a held part fits a socket in is scored by these and the best is the ghost's first guess. upright, front and facing are times a cosine (-1 to 1); mirror, lastChoice and learned are added when the turn matches exactly; neighbour times the share of the same parts next to it that match; coveredSocket is taken off for each free socket it would cover (at most 4), facingWall when its face is right against a part. Ties keep the old fixed order. Each is 0 to 100.
